source_readings.existing_stake_options: eliminate transferBond via unbond/rebond, or delayed transfer
source_readings.transfer_requirement_locators: SRC-LP20-OCT L246-258, L592-597; unsettled tradeoff L525
source_readings.clock_reading: 21 rounds at L233/L592; 21 day at L248/L250 and 21-day at L257 not equated
source_readings.source_exposure: continued source exposure supported by L251-253/L595-597; exact earnings/score snapshot and eligibility illustrative
source_readings.instant_path: requires resolving L525 against stated elimination-or-delay requirement

receipt_boundary.scope: node-envelope LPT and USDC fee shares only; validator-envelope participant receipts excluded
receipt_boundary.seat_interaction: target arrival top-N eligibility, donor eligibility, composition/scoring interests and governance vote weight unassessed; carry to GT-09/final disposition
receipt_boundary.excluded_source_return: omission can understate forgone source return if donor registers and shares validator pay; no unconditional observed loss
receipt_boundary.delegator_lpt: eligible participant stake / current pool eligible stake * (1-k) * scored pool node reward
receipt_boundary.delegator_usdc: eligible participant stake / current pool eligible stake * d * .5 * pool fees USDC
receipt_boundary.ownership_clock: earning-cohort stake determines later claim rights; fees use earning snapshot
receipt_boundary.moving_principal_source: outside-delegated donor stake; operator-owned initial amount held fixed; donor owned fraction recomputed
receipt_boundary.donor_effect: pool node reward, remaining-delegator receipts and moving-delegator forgone receipts separately reported; no presumed sign

persistence_boundary.identity: max(0,last persistence round-eligibility round+1) within earning window
persistence_boundary.interpretation: overlap fixed by illustrative persistence and eligibility; no empirical duration result
persistence_boundary.exit_basis: modeler-fixed at 24, not observed decline or delegator foresight

score_boundary.identity: claim-time median m multiplies operator/delegator node-envelope LPT; m=0 gives zero cohort LPT
score_boundary.capital: locked, not confiscated; source score exposure during wait per declared reading
score_boundary.anticipation: unmodelled; no detection probability or new rows
